writeup: This new white darkFlash PMT1050 is a fully modular 1050W 80 Plus Gold ATX 3.1 power supply with native 12V-2x6 / PCIe 5.1, now $59.99. Newegg has the same white 1050W unit in stock at $119.99, and darkFlash's site lists it at $129.99, so this is 50% and about $60 below the lowest store price. Woot showed 10 or more left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
